title: Learning doesn’t stop at the classroom door.
alt: Students working on robots together in the classroom
summary: From hands-on projects to Cambodia Robotics Olympiad participation, our learners take their ideas into the wider robotics community.

sections.heading: Ideas become something you can build
sections.text: Robotics brings science, technology, engineering and mathematics together. At RobotYOUNG Academy, learners explore these subjects through hands-on projects, turning ideas into builds they can test and improve.

sections.heading: A wider community of makers
sections.text: Learning reaches beyond classroom activities through student projects and Cambodia Robotics Olympiad participation. Explore the academy’s project page for a closer look at what young makers are working on.

title: Plan their next learning adventure.
alt: A learner programming beside wheeled robots
summary: A starting point for curious minds: discover programs, ask questions and find a learning path that fits your child.

sections.heading: Start with their curiosity
sections.text: The academy offers learning opportunities in robotics, coding, AI and IoT, drones and more. Browse the program summaries and learning path to see where your child’s interests could lead.

sections.heading: Talk to us about availability
sections.text: Ask the academy about current class openings and the next Summer Camp. Dates and availability are confirmed directly by the academy, so get in touch before making your plans.

title: Stay curious. Stay connected.
alt: An exhibitor sharing robot models with visitors
summary: Workshops, STEM activities and the robotics community: there is always another question worth exploring.

sections.heading: Make room for discovery
sections.text: Building, experimenting and sharing ideas are part of the academy’s hands-on approach. Workshops and STEM activities offer opportunities to connect those interests with other curious learners.

sections.heading: Keep in touch with the academy
sections.text: Contact RobotYOUNG Academy for workshop announcements, STEM activities and competition updates. The team can confirm what is coming up and help you find a suitable opportunity.
